title: Ramsey numbers of multiple copies of a graph and the random Ramsey theorem
summary: A well-known result of Burr, Erdős and Spencer [Transactions of the American Mathematical Society, 1975] determines the $2$-colour Ramsey number for any sufficiently large collection of vertex-disjoint copies of a fixed graph $H$ without isolated vertices. A focus of this paper is to give analogous results for the corresponding $r$-colour Ramsey problem. More precisely we determine, up to an additive constant, this Ramsey number in the case when $r=3$ and also in the case when the chromatic number of $H$ is at least $r$.
